preconditions.description: The number of testcases T is between 1 and 4000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= N <= 10**5 for N in [int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(T)])
preconditions.description: For each testcase, the length of the binary string N is between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(S) == N for N, S in [(int(input().split()[0]), input().strip()) for _ in range(T)])
preconditions.description: For each testcase, the length of the binary string S matches the given length N.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c in '01' for c in S) for N, S in [(int(input().split()[0]), input().strip()) for _ in range(T)])
preconditions.description: For each testcase, the binary string S contains only the characters '0' and '1'.

preconditions.expression: sum(N for N, S in [(int(input().split()[0]), input().strip()) for _ in range(T)]) <= 10**5
preconditions.description: The sum of the lengths of all binary strings S across all testcases does not exceed 10^5.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(result, int) for result in results)
postconditions.description: The output for each testcase is an integer.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= result <= (N // 2) for result, N in zip(results, [int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(T)]))
postconditions.description: The output for each testcase is between 0 and N // 2 inclusive, where N is the length of the binary string S.

postconditions.expression: all(result == max(S[i:i+2].count('01') for i in range(N-1)) for result, N, S in zip(results, [int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(T)], [input().strip() for _ in range(T)]))
postconditions.description: The output for each testcase is the maximum number of occurrences of the substring '01' in any string that can be obtained by performing the allowed swaps on the binary string S.
